sentences.text: In the aforesaid case, pendingdisposal of the instant application.

It is expedient in the interest of justice that further proceedings in the case before the trial court may be directed to remain stayed and be further pleased to pass such other and/or further order as may be deemed fit and proper in the circumstances of the case."
4.

At the very outset, the learned A.G.A. for State-opposite party-1 has raised a preliminary objection by submitting that present application has been filed after expiry of a period of almost 1 year and 6 months from the date of Cognizance Taking Order i.e. 14.09.2023 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Aligarh.
As such, the present application is hopelessly barred by delay/laches.

It is then contended that the affidavit filed in support of present application runs into as many as 29 paragraphs, however, no attempt has been made to explain the delay/laches in filing the present application sufficiently.
As such, the delay/laches in filing present application remains unexplained sufficiently.
In view of above, no indulgence be granted by this Court in present application.
Consequently, the present application is liable to be dismissed on the ground of delay/laches.
5. When confronted with above, the learned counsel for applicant invited the attention of Court to paragraph 27 of the affidavit filed in support of present application.

For ready reference, the same is reproduced herein below:-
"

It is further stated that the applicant has somehow been able to arrange financial resources to contest the instant case and any such delay in approaching this Hon'ble Court is not deliberate and as such any delay occasioned in filing the instant application be ignored."
6.

Upon perusal of aforementioned paragraph, it is apparent that the explanation offered for explaining the delay in filing the present application, neither prima-facie appears to be sufficient nor truthful.
As such, the delay in filing the present application has not been sufficiently explained.

7. Having heard, the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State-opposite party-1 and upon perusal of record, this Court finds that the explanation offered by the applicant for explaining the delay/laches in filing the present application is neither sufficient nor truthful.

In view of above,
the delay/laches in filing the present application remains unexplained.
8. As a result, the present application fails and is liable to be dismissed on the ground of delay/laches.
